'''''Caulerpa chemnitzia''''' is a species of seaweed in the ''[[Caulerpaceae]]'' family.<ref name=FloraBase>{{FloraBase|name=''Caulerpa chemnitzia''|id=42620}}</ref>

It is found along the coast in a large area extending from north of [[Perth, Western Australia|Perth]] to the [[Kimberley (Western Australia)|Kimberley]] region of Western Australia.
